paper.title: Algorithm 833: CSRFPACK: interpolation of scattered data with a C1 convexity-preserving surface
paper.venue: ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 30(2) (TOMS 833, June 2004), 200
paper.note: DOI not verified in this wake; the article itself was not read, so the claim rests on the shipped driver output (Fortran77/Drivers/res).

code.archive: sha256 e40e3df805baca94da32f5b9bd460abb8f03049675da6573bf1b7439819a7720 (netlib.org/toms/833.gz as fetched 2026-11-26, HTTP 200; a shell archive created 2004-08-25 with Fortran77/Src/src.f, Fortran77/Drivers/driver.f, data and res)
code.note: Fortran 77. Extract with /bin/sh after removing the lines above '#! /bin/sh'. The driver is CSRFTEST (author's test driver, dated 06/25/02). It reads the data file (8 nodes) and writes a 40 x 40 grid of interpolated values to csrftest.out, and it writes the printed parameters to csrftest.prt.

claim.location: The shipped driver output Fortran77/Drivers/res, the grid block that begins with the count 1600 (line 1668 of the shell archive). Its second row, X = -0.948717948717949, Y = -1.000000000000000, gives the interpolated value 0.189783809135176E+01. The first row (X=-1, Y=-1) gives 2.0, the data value at that node.
claim.metric: Interpolated surface value F at grid node (X,Y) = (-0.948717948717949, -1.0) printed by the author's driver with the data file.
claim.paper_value: Not used: the TOMS article was not read in this wake; the value is taken from the shipped driver output.

values.name: F(X=-0.948717948717949, Y=-1.0) from CSRFTEST with the shipped data file

tolerance.basis: Fixed before any run. The shipped output prints 15 significant digits in double precision (D exponents), so its own rounding is about 1e-15. 1e-9 absorbs compiler and libm differences in a convex-surface computation that uses only arithmetic, while a wrong convexity or interpolation step moves this node by far more. Not to be loosened after any run.

cost.cpu_minutes_estimate: Under 5 minutes: one Fortran compile of src.f and driver.f and one run on 8 nodes.
cost.data_size: 8 data points, in the shipped data file.
cost.data_licence: Netlib TOMS code under the ACM licence; the rerun should record the licence text.

why: A deterministic double-precision interpolation code whose author's driver prints a full grid of surface values, so the claim tests the convex C1 construction at a node that is not a data point.
